key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=5% more than placebo): thirst, dry mouth, asthenia, constipation, pollakiuria or polyuria, hyperglycemia. In the pivotal trials dry mouth occurred in 13% (tolvaptan) vs 4% (placebo) and thirst 16% vs 5%. Most serious risk is too-rapid serum sodium correction causing osmotic demyelination.
